en:
That's it! Angie went to that room
to get a candle!
Yeah! For kinky waxplay!

Uh, no... Angie was gonna use it
for the ritual.

According to the Necronomicon, to
<CLT=cltSTRONG>resurrect the dead<CLT=cltNORMAL>...

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>After preparing the effigy,
burn this Necronomicon to ashes.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Use caution! Be mindful of
carbon monoxide poisoning!

Then, did she seek out a candle so she
could burn the book?

That's right! There's nothing to start a fire
with in Angie's lab...

So she went to go get a candle from
one of the empty rooms!
And that's when the culprit attacked her!

That's why there was dried blood under
floor...

Which means, Angie was attacked in
the same room the seance was held!

Bravo, Himiko! Well done for choosing 
that room for the seance!
Nyeh...?

If we hadn't done the seance in that room, then
Tenko's murder would've been in another room.

If that happened, no one would've discovered
Angie's bloodstain under the floorboards.

That's right. Shuichi and I only checked under
the floorboards where Tenko died.

Yup, it's all thanks to Himiko for choosing 
the same room as Angie!

This must be Atua's will!
Or maybe the power of magic?

It's neither...
I just picked one.

Hold on... You're all acting as though
you've proven that as fact already.

You claim Angie was murdered in the
empty room and then moved to the lab?

Then how do you explain the large
amount of blood in the lab?

It may be possible to carry a body,
but blood cannot be moved.

I think she was still alive after
the attack in the empty room.

She was killed after she was
carried to her lab.

<CLT=cltMIND>That means the culprit attacked her twice.
I have evidence of that.

There was blood on the katana, correct?
So Angie was killed in the lab—

So you understand, yes? Angie's murder
happened entirely in the lab...

That's why I couldn't have done it.
Don't accuse me with your shoddy logic.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

Hm, that reminds me... Wasn't there something
strange on Angie's body?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

What relevance does that have? None. 
There is no evidence to prove it...
Is there really no evidence though?

If she didn't die in the empty room,
then why was she attacked twice?

The culprit must've been a 
big, bad meanie to do that!

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

What is the proof Angie was still
alive after being attacked?

The fatal wound was a cut to the back
of her neck from a katana.

But she also showed signs of <CLT=cltSTRONG>blunt
force trauma<CLT=cltNORMAL>, and I think I know why.

After Angie was knocked unconscious in the
empty room, she was killed in her lab.

I see! So that puddle of blood
is from the killing blow!
Hah! It's all clear now!

Angie was attacked in the empty room, 
carried to her lab...

And it was there that the culprit
finished her off!
All clear...? This...is all clear?

Kehe...kehehehe...
What are you all talking about...?

All...clear...?
Wh-What...is...a-all clear...?

What is... What are you...
A-All clear...?

Wh-What are... You all...you. 
You what? Wha-Wha-What are—
Sweet Korekiyo, calm yourself...

Their words are all hollow.
There is no meaning to any of them...
<CLT=cltMIND>...What?

You must teach these
ignorant children a lesson.

Y-Yes, you're right...
Okay, I'll teach them.

Wh-What the hell are you mumblin' about?
You're givin' me the goddamn willies...

Kehehe... Not yet.
Nothing is clear at all.

It's full of doubts! Of mysteries!
Of a dense, impenetrable fog!
Nothing is clear at all!!!
